udt_struct_v0.doc: A single escrow agreement between a client and a freelancer.
udt_struct_v0.name: Deal

fields.doc: Locked amount, in the token's smallest unit.
fields.name: amount

fields.doc: The paying party; the only address allowed to settle the deal.
fields.name: client

fields.doc: The working party; receives the funds on `release`.
fields.name: freelancer

fields.doc: Current lifecycle state of the deal.
fields.name: state

fields.doc: SEP-41 token contract used for payment (XLM or USDC SAC).
fields.name: token

cases.doc: `init` was called with a `deal_id` that already holds a deal.
cases.name: AlreadyInitialized

cases.doc: The deal was queried or settled before `init`.
cases.name: NotInitialized

cases.doc: The escrow amount must be strictly positive.
cases.name: InvalidAmount

cases.doc: The deal was already released or refunded.
cases.name: AlreadySettled

cases.doc: `anchor` was called with a `record_id` that is already taken.
cases.name: AlreadyAnchored

cases.doc: The record was queried before it was anchored.
cases.name: NotFound

fields.doc: Ledger timestamp when the record was anchored.
fields.name: anchored_at

fields.doc: The wallet that authored \xe2\x80\x94 and signed for \xe2\x80\x94 the record.
fields.name: author

fields.doc: `sha256` of the canonical content, computed off-chain.
fields.name: commitment

fields.doc: Whether the record commits to a job post or a deal agreement.
fields.name: kind

udt_union_v0.doc: Lifecycle of a deal. Funds may leave the contract exactly once.
udt_union_v0.name: DealState

udt_union_v0.doc: What a registry record commits to.
udt_union_v0.name: RecordKind

void_v0.doc: A direct-deal (order) agreement between a client and a freelancer.
void_v0.name: Deal

function_v0.doc: Locks `amount` of `token` from `client` into the contract under\n`deal_id`. Requires the client's signature. Fails if `deal_id` is taken.
function_v0.name: init

function_v0.doc: The address allowed to upgrade the contract.
function_v0.name: admin

function_v0.doc: Anchors `commitment` under `record_id`, authored by `author`. Requires\nthe author's signature; records are write-once.
function_v0.name: anchor

function_v0.doc: Returns the locked funds to the client (client cancels before delivery).
function_v0.name: refund

function_v0.doc: Pays the locked funds out to the freelancer (client confirms delivery).
function_v0.name: release

function_v0.doc: Swaps the contract's Wasm for a new build, keeping the same contract id\nand all stored deals and records. Only the admin may upgrade.
function_v0.name: upgrade

function_v0.doc: The deployed contract version \xe2\x80\x94 changes when a new build is upgraded in.
function_v0.name: version

function_v0.doc: Returns a deal, for status displays and CLI inspection.
function_v0.name: get_deal

function_v0.doc: Returns an anchored record, for verification and CLI inspection.
function_v0.name: get_record

function_v0.doc: Sets the upgrade admin. Runs once, at deployment.
function_v0.name: __constructor
